label: TP
reason: Both findings represent real vulnerabilities: (1) java.util.Random.nextGaussian() provides non-cryptographic randomness suitable for authentication tokens (lines 54, 83), and (2) user-controlled values from headers and cookies are concatenated directly into HTML output via PrintWriter without escaping (lines 92-97)

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source using java.util.Random for token generation
XSS vulnerability - user input concatenated into HTML output without escaping
